issue.title: Symvision epic-symbol bead lookup can transiently miss an existing in-progress bead
issue.description: During unrelated runner-slot queue work on 2026-08-10, mandatory `just check` passed fmt, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology, then failed at lint (symvision): `Error: --epic-symbol 'sase-i8(MergeSummary)': bead 'sase-i8' not found. Remove this --epic-symbol entry.` The failure is not a stale whitelist entry: immediately afterward `SASE_SYMVISION_BEAD_STATUS_ONLY=1 tools/sase_bead show sase-i8` resolved the in-progress epic, and the exact Symvision invocation from the Justfile with `BD_COMMAND=tools/sase_bead` passed with `All public/private classes/functions are used properly!`. Investigate why the Symvision epic-symbol bead status lookup can transiently miss a bead that the same wrapper can resolve, and make the lint gate deterministic or emit a retryable diagnostic. This blocks clean unrelated `just check` runs when it recurs.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during distinct_notification_tab_icons verification on 2026-08-10: after just install and targeted notification tests passed, just check-full passed fmt, markdown fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology, then failed at lint (symvision) with: Error: --epic-symbol 'sase-i8(MergeSummary)': bead 'sase-i8' not found. Remove this --epic-symbol entry. The same workspace's in-progress epic sweep resolved and showed sase-i8 immediately afterward, so this corroborates a transient status-only lookup miss rather than a stale whitelist entry.

payload.entry: Verified with just install; just _lint-symvision x3; just check; and .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_sase_bead_tool.py.

evidence.note: Post-close reproduction on 2026-08-12 at sase fd7719cdb: after just test passed 29,002 tests, just check passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and terminology, then Symvision failed with Error: --epic-symbol 'sase-js(ArtifactRefKindAlias)': bead 'sase-js' not found. An immediate sase bead list --type plan --tier epic --status in_progress --format full resolved sase-js as IN_PROGRESS, confirming the same transient status-only lookup miss rather than a stale exemption.

payload.entry: Third independent reproduction on 2026-08-12 while implementing plan_toast_tier_and_epic_counts.md (sase_15): after 'just install' and 'just fmt' passed, 'just check' passed fmt/ruff/mypy/pyscripts/test-waits/changelog/terminology, then Symvision failed with the same error: --epic-symbol 'sase-js(ArtifactRefKindAlias)': bead 'sase-js' not found (and the other 5 sase-js(...) entries). An immediate 'sase bead show sase-js' resolved it as IN_PROGRESS with 5 closed phases, confirming the same transient status-only lookup miss. Worked around by running symvision manually without --epic-symbol to verify my own changes had zero findings, then proceeded without editing the Justfile whitelist (bead sase-js is genuinely still active, not stale).

Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest; master 443566f7d). sase-km: the gap is confirmed still open -- neither tools/probe_core_floor nor tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings references any *_wire_schema_version, so a schema bump can still ship under a floor that rejects it. It is closed as preventive rather than active: the breakage it was filed for (sase-lm) is resolved, those suites pass today, and tools/validate_sase_core_rs_version now explains the dev-install window mismatch instead of failing on it. sase-it: a single transient symvision epic-symbol bead-lookup miss from 2026-08-10 that did not reproduce on the immediate retry with the identical Justfile invocation; symvision itself is an external tool, so the fix likely does not live in this repo. Re-file either with a +1 -- sase-km on the next real floor/schema mismatch, sase-it on a second transient miss.

payload.close_reason: Deprioritized in the 2026-08-14 task-backlog triage: one preventive gate and one unreproduced transient, closed in favor of live defects.
